verdict.rationale: Ultrametric installs a single SKILL.md into Codex and Claude Code skill directories. `init --dry-run` previews exactly which skill files will be created before anything is written, and the files can be committed for team review, which gives some advance visibility into the agent's new behavior. However, nothing in the evidence shows what the SKILL.md contains, whether it describes what the skill does, or when it activates. Missing for 10: documented skill contents describing purpose, documented activation triggers or conditions, per-skill reference docs, independent corroboration of skill documentation quality.
